channel_standard: User-confirmed channel image standard (2026-10-13). The character may change; these rules stay.
line_art: Thin, delicate fine-ink line art: hairline strokes, precise eyes, sparse halftone shading. No thick outlines, no heavy cel shading, no saturated flat fills.
color: Soft, subtle, low-intensity watercolor/marker wash on the figure only: gentle skin warmth, faint blush on cheeks and lips. Hair stays mostly black ink.
framing: Straight front view, looking at the viewer, shoulders level. Head and shoulders only: broad relaxed shoulders slope gently outward and exit the bottom edge of the frame near 10% and 90% of its width, before rounding into the arms. No upper arms visible; only a thin band of clothing below the neckline.
variable_per_world: Clothing, accessories and props carry each world's theme.
